Hyperalloy is synthesized at the atomic level and refined with coltan extracted from certain gemstones. Its unparalleled toughness and strength make it suitable for nearly any application. If only it weren't so hard to fabricate.

value.label: Fabricate beta poly x15
value.description:
TIER 5 - Ultra Tech >>> Optimal Durability, Temperature regulation >> Suitable Production X Inadvisable Weight, Production
Tools Recommended: Digging, Mining, Building
Originally developed as military hardware, polymimetic alloy is programmable matter which is able to change states between liquid and solid. This allows it to be quickly formed and can maintain a rigid or flexible shape, suitible for everything from clothes, weapons, buildings, and armor. Because it can reform when damaged, it has unmatched longevity as a material.
